scheme_name: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Scheme of Assistance for Strengthening the Regulation and Environmental Compliance
other_conditions: Eligible entities include industries association, any enterprise (except captive use), or firms registered under the Societies Act, Trust Act, or Companies Act; as well as GIDC/Board, corporations, special purpose vehicles (SPV), PSU, municipal corporations, nagarpalikas, or urban development authorities.
Projects must comply with Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF) and Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) regulations.
The project must remain operational for a minimum of 5 years after completion.
benefits_summary: Need‑based financial support up to ₹50,00,000, disbursed in phases as decided by the State Level Empowered Committee.
